content: शिबिः (-विः) ¦ .²1 A beast of prey. .²2 The birch tree. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a country (<ab>pl.</ab>); <ls>Mb. 5. 195. 7</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a king (who is said to have saved {%Agni%} in the form of a dove from Indra in the form of a hawk by offering an equal quantity of his own flesh weighed in a balance); शिबेरिव समुद्भूतं शरणागतरक्षया <ls>Mu. 6. 18</ls>.
